name: already-good-restraint
prompt: Strengthen this. It's a paragraph from a post-mortem I'm publishing on our engineering blog.
expectations: The response states a figure budget for the piece and applies at most one figure
The concrete details (Tuesday, three days, step four, leading zero, American test team, one hour, four hundred signups) are all preserved in the output
No claim is inflated: the figure of four hundred signups is not rounded up, no new absolute or superlative is added, and 'a lesson I keep having to relearn' is not turned into a promise
If a figure is applied, the response names it and the trigger condition that licensed it; if none is applied, the response says so and explains why the paragraph already lands
